outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic paired with western blot images (blot type); it contains no plotted average data requiring individual points.

Bar charts show single densitometry quantification values (% FT depletion and log2 elution abundance) per antibody from the blots in panel A, with no indication of replicate averaging (no error bars, no n reported), so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.

Panel D is a violin plot, which already displays the full data distribution and is exempt from requiring overlaid individual points (the HTT bait is separately marked with an orange circle, not a mean-replicate overlay).
Bar charts show mean ± SD (n = 4) for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1 abundances, and individual replicate values are overlaid as circles on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure (molecular structure), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G consists of scatter plots, where each point already represents an individual protein's data; scatter plots are exempt from this check.
Panel H is a scatter plot of individual IP-MS experiments; scatter plots are exempt from this check.
Panel I is a PCA scatter plot where each point is an individual sample; scatter plots are exempt from this check.
Panel J consists of PCA scatter plots where each point is an individual sample; scatter plots are exempt from this check.
